messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-Critical-98765 fired for gpu-node-73: kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady (us-west-2b). Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/98765 :rotating_light:

Maya: acked the page. I'm grabbing the node metadata and recent kubelet logs.

Ben: oncall infra here. ping me console output + BMC creds if you have them.

Samir: I'm jumping in for SRE. Quick check: any scheduled kernel/driver updates landed last night on that rack? Jules, you mentioned a firmware window?

Jules: there was a staged firmware push to one rack in us-west-2b yesterday night, rolled to 3 hosts. I'll check if gpu-node-73 got it.

Maya: running `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-73` - I see 9 pods, incl. 2 dedicated inference (cust-beta-prod) and 1 heavy batch (cust-delta).

Ben: node not responding to kubelet pings. BMC reachable. Pulling serial console now.

Ben: console shows: `Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt` then repeated reboots. Looks like immediate kernel crash on early init.

Maya: customers affected: cust-beta production (degraded throughput on a subset of requests), cust-delta batch (3 jobs failed). CS-Lina notified customers and escalating.

CS-Lina: notified cust-delta; they're ok with retries but want ETA. Cust-beta is monitoring, asked for updates every 15m.

Samir: mitigation plan: cordon node, drain, RMA request via infra portal, replace node from pool. If autoscaler has no spare capacity, temporarily relax pod anti-affinity for emergency reschedule.

Ben: executing now.

```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-73
kubectl drain gpu-node-73 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

incident-bot: drain started by Ben at 2026-03-14T04:02:13Z

Ben: drain completed for most pods. Two large stateful batch jobs failed on eviction - marking for manual retry.

Maya: scheduler rescheduled most inference pods to gpu-node-84 and gpu-node-85. Latency SLOs briefly saw tail spikes (~200ms extra) for ~3-4 minutes. No client-facing errors logged beyond retries.

Jules: opened hardware ticket INFRA-4999 and attached BMC console dump + dmesg. Requesting on-site swap.

Samir: autoscaler info: no warm spare nodes in that AZ. I've temporarily patched deployment affinity to allow emergency co-location for 10 minutes.

Ben: patch applied:
```
kubectl patch deployment inference-worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"redwood/sched-override":"true"}}}}}'
```

Maya: CS updated both customers: cust-beta saw limited throughput hit, cust-delta batch window delayed ~25 minutes while jobs retried.

Samir: proposing follow-ups: (1) verify if firmware update correlates with kernel panic; (2) scan cluster for similar oops signatures; (3) add preflight to staging to block bad firmware pushes.

Jules: confirmed gpu-node-73 had a firmware staging artifact applied yesterday. Adding that to INFRA-4999.

Ben: running grep across node logs for similar traces: `grep -R "Kernel panic - not syncing" /var/log/nodes/*`

Maya: automation note: we've seen a few hard OOMs and kernel oops after that driver build in staging. Flagging research team.

Samir: if RMA ETA > 3h we should rebalance capacity to other AZs. I've pinged infra lead and colo ops.

CS-Lina: cust-delta confirmed backfill succeeded, they closed ticket. Cust-beta still watching, asked for final postmortem.

Ben: colo scheduled swap attempt at 2026-03-14T07:00Z. If hardware swap doesn't fix it, we'll reprovision new host from pool and reprovision GPU drivers/firmware pinned to last-known-good.

Maya: postmortem owners: Samir (lead), Ben (infra follow-up), Jules (firmware), Maya (customer liaison), CS-Lina (customer comms).

Samir: handoff: I'll own next 6 hours for follow-up. Ben, please update INFRA-4999 with any console changes. Jules, coordinate firmware rollback plan. Maya/CS-Lina, please collect exact request ids for cust-beta failed requests.

Ben: noted. Leaving node cordoned until RMA completes or swap proven good.

incident-bot: PD incident PD-Critical-98765 acknowledged by Maya at 2026-03-14T04:01:05Z

Samir: running final cluster-wide scan for `not syncing` and `NULL pointer` traces, will report findings in follow-up thread.

Jules: temporarily lowering alert sensitivity for that rack to reduce alert noise during RMA window.

Ben: marking this Slack thread as mitigation-complete: services rescheduled, customers notified, RMA opened. Will continue monitoring.

incident-bot: thread closed by Samir at 2026-03-14T05:28:20Z

Maya: thanks team. Postmortem ETA EOD 2026-03-15. Follow-ups in #incidents and INFRA-4999.
